# SCRUM-56 - User is notified when clarification is requested

| | |
|---|---|
| **Epic** | SCRUM-8 - Event Change & Notifications |
| **Priority** | High |
| **Story points** | 1 |
| **Status in Jira** | To Do |
| **Sprint** | Backlog |
| **Jira** | https://smu-spm-group7.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-56 |

---

As an Event Organiser, I want to be notified when a Coordinator requests clarification on my submitted event request, so that I know to respond.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Given a Coordinator requests clarification on a submitted request, when the request is saved, then a notification is created for the Organiser.
* Given the notification is created, when the Organiser opens it, then it shows what clarification is being asked for.
